description: This file defines the 'PersonState' class used for managing person-related state in an event-sourced system, with methods to apply various events to modify state.

classes.name: PersonState
classes.description: Serializable class representing a person's current state, including first name, last name, gender, and marital status, with methods to apply different event types.

methods.name: Apply(PersonRegistered @event)
methods.description: Updates the person's first name, last name, and gender based on the 'PersonRegistered' event.

methods.name: Apply(PersonMarried @event)
methods.description: Sets the 'IsMarried' status to true in response to a 'PersonMarried' event.

methods.name: Apply(PersonLastNameChanged @event)
methods.description: Updates the last name based on the 'PersonLastNameChanged' event.
